$comment: Fieldstone Labs (plugin-debug's Fieldstone sample space) scopes the task 'Ship the Cairn dashboard as a Composer plugin'. Astrid is the local user; the others are simulated participants. heygen.mjs casts stock avatars and voices into <out>/cast.json unless a participant sets avatarId/voiceId.

astrid.name: Astrid Holm
astrid.look: woman, late 30s, short dark hair, navy sweater, home office with bookshelves

lucia.name: Lucía Ferreira
lucia.look: woman, early 30s, long dark hair, mustard cardigan, studio with posters

ben.name: Ben Achterberg
ben.look: man, late 20s, curly hair, glasses, grey hoodie, room with whiteboard

tomas.name: Tomás Vidal
tomas.look: man, 40s, short beard, light blue shirt, office meeting pod

lines.speaker: astrid
lines.text: Thanks for jumping on. Today we scope the Cairn dashboard as a Composer plugin. Lucía, what do customers need first?

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: Cache hit rate per repo, and which builds missed. Okapi asked for exactly that twice last month.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: I sketched it as a plank: a hit-rate chart across the top, and a table of recent builds underneath.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: The table can be a live query over build records, so it updates the moment Builder pushes a run.

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: Can we flag the slowest misses? That's the conversation we want to have with customers.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Sure. A red badge on any miss over a minute, linking straight to its trace.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: I'll have Builder draft the query, and I can show a first cut in storybook on Thursday.

lines.speaker: astrid
lines.text: Great. Ben shares the sketch today, Tomás builds the plank, and Lucía checks it with Okapi. Thanks, everyone.
